summary: Frontend-only testing of Edit Quotation feature on /quotations. Tested Sales and Super Admin flows. All acceptance criteria met.
seed_data_creation: None; existing DRAFT quotations used (QT-00002, QT-00004).

(c) Editing QT-00004 pax 2->5 & discount 8->5 -> toast 'Quotation diperbarui' shown, row updated to 5 pax / Rp 95.550.000 / diskon 5%. (d) After edit, opening New Quotation resets form (pax=1, discount=0, title 'New Quotation', save 'Create quotation').
